reason: Modifying /etc/fstab to add the nosuid option changes filesystem mount behavior. An incorrect entry can prevent the system from booting or cause loss of setuid functionality for applications in /home, which may break user workflows. Because this is a filesystem/partitioning change, the policy classifies it as too dangerous to remediate automatically.
estimated_impact: reboot required; filesystems affected; Potential boot failure if fstab syntax is incorrect; Loss of setuid/sgid binaries in /home may break applications; Requires reboot to apply the change
